name: MicWatch
author: Hermes Agent
description: Move members to another voice channel when they keep their microphone open (or actually talk) for longer than a configurable threshold. Two detection modes: 'mic' (voice state, no voice connection needed) and 'speak' (voice gateway speaking events, bot has to sit in the channel).
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the user IDs of members you add to a guild's immunity list in Red's Config. Removing a member from the list or running the data-deletion request removes their ID.
install_msg: Thanks for installing MicWatch! Use `[p]micwatch` to configure it. The 'mic' mode needs no extra setup; the 'speak' mode additionally needs voice support in the bot venv (`pip install -U "Red-DiscordBot[voice]"`, or `[p]pipinstall pynacl davey`) and the bot has to sit in the watched voice channel. Required permission: **Move Members** (+ Connect for 'speak' mode).
short: Move members with an open mic to another channel
